  {"step":2,"file":"options.c","function":"fio_options_parse","line":5195,"var":"opts_copy","code":"opts_copy = dup_and_sub_options(opts, num_opts);","note":"fio_options_parse creates a duplicated option array for in-place keyword substitution."},
  {"step":3,"file":"options.c","function":"dup_and_sub_options","line":5147,"var":"opts_copy[i]","code":"opts_copy[i] = fio_option_dup_subs(opts[i]);","note":"The duplicated option string is handed to the reserved-keyword expander."},
  {"step":4,"file":"options.c","function":"fio_keyword_replace","line":5101,"var":"s","code":"while ((s = strstr(opt, kw->word)) != NULL) {","note":"The $ncpus keyword is located inside the attacker-controlled description string."},

  {"step":6,"file":"options.c","function":"fio_keyword_replace","line":5120,"var":"opt","code":"if (strlen(opt)) memcpy(new + olen + len, opt, opt - o_org - 1);","note":"The pointer advance makes the tail copy depend on the shifted source address rather than the actual remaining bytes."},
  {"step":7,"file":"options.c","function":"fio_keyword_replace","line":5121,"var":"memcpy(new + olen + len, opt, opt - o_org - 1);","code":"if (strlen(opt)) memcpy(new + olen + len, opt, opt - o_org - 1);","note":"This copies past the intended source range and is the heap-overflow sink during keyword replacement."},
  {"step":8,"file":"options.c","function":"fio_options_parse","line":5200,"var":"parse_option(...)","code":"parse_option(opts_copy[i], opts[i], fio_options, &o, &td->o, &td->opt_list);","note":"The corrupted substituted string is then consumed by the parser after the overflow has occurred."}
